name: Shannon A. Brennan
residence: Moran, Teton County (Jackson mailing city on the candidate filing)
occupation: Energy and environmental management consultant; owner and CEO of Shannon A. Brennan & Associates LLC (campaign site)
background: Shannon A. Brennan's campaign site describes her as an energy and environmental management consultant who lives in Moran, in House District 23, and as the owner and CEO of Shannon A. Brennan & Associates LLC, an SBA-certified women-owned small business.

The same campaign biography says she holds a master's degree in public administration and Stanford certifications in advanced project management and energy innovation, and that she has served in the U.S. Departments of the Treasury, Health and Human Services, and Energy, and other federal and state agencies, across a 35-year career in public service. It also describes her as a Senior Fellow with the Partnership for Public Service.

Her campaign site states that she served on the Teton County Board of Health (2022–2026), is a trustee of St. John's Health, sits on the Wyoming Governor's Groundwater Advisory Committee, and is active with Rotary International and the Jackson Hole Chamber of Commerce.
education: Master's degree in public administration (institution not named on the campaign site); Stanford SCPD and SAPM certifications (campaign site)
